patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with alternating background colors, often featuring large, impactful imagery or custom illustrations that span the width of the viewport.
A highly distinctive, extra-bold, wide sans-serif font is used for primary headings, creating a strong visual anchor, contrasted with an elegant serif for subheadings and body text.
A vibrant, high-contrast palette featuring a dominant royal blue, a warm cream, and a punchy orange, complemented by rich, illustrative accent colors like purple, dark green, and yellow.
A repeating background text pattern ('MOTHER OF SEAFOOD SINCE 1979') scrolls at a different rate than the foreground content, creating a layered parallax effect that adds depth to the page.
Content sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, guiding the user's attention through the page content.
Prominent use of custom, playful, and abstract illustrations that integrate seamlessly with photographic elements and text, often overlapping or framing content.

technique_notes: The site uses a layered scrolling effect where a large, repeating background text pattern scrolls at a slower rate than the main content, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger, given the hint) that makes them slide upwards and fade in as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Custom, stylized illustrations are integrated throughout the design, often overlapping or interacting with photographic elements and text, contributing to a unique and playful brand identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (up to ~4-5x body text) with a contrasting, elegant serif for readable body and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and image containers, providing a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with balanced spacing within content blocks to maintain readability.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost playful custom typography and the unique, abstract illustrations that are seamlessly integrated with photography. The layered parallax background text also creates a memorable and dynamic visual experience, setting it apart from typical marketing sites.
